name: Ecliptic Distaff

frame.name: Adaptive Glaive
frame.description: Balances melee/ranged polearm with a frontal shield. Generates shield energy after dealing ranged damage.

origins.name: Vanguard's Vindication
origins.description: Final blows with this weapon grant a small amount of health.

origins.name: One Quiet Moment
origins.description: Grants increased reload speed and handling when out of combat. Swords gain faster movement speed.

origins.name: Gun and Run
origins.description: Defeating targets builds stacks of Gun and Run for a short duration. Sprinting for a short time consumes a stack to partially reload this weapon's magazine from reserves; on Bows, this briefly improves draw speed.

perks.name: Ballistic Tuning
perks.description:
Power diverted from shield.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases shield duration

perks.name: Alloy Magazine
perks.description: Faster reload when the magazine is nearly empty.

perks.name: Replenishing Aegis
perks.description: Blocking damage partially reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Close to Melee
perks.description: Glaive projectile final blows improve Glaive melee damage. Glaive projectile or melee damage extends the duration.

flavor: "We Awoken spin our paths from Light and Darkness." —Mara Sov
